name: NYC x DSSG
heroSubtitle: From tech unemployment to career-ready work.
heroDescription: Global entry-level tech jobs have significantly plummeted since 2022, putting early-career young talent at historic risk of prolonged unemployment. The Data Diplomats shifts the paradigm by providing training program that matches job-seeking technologists to the nonprofit sector, enabling social workers and NGOs to solve real grassroots social challenges through human-centered AI.
